envelope.description: Forward the docs area at both dispatch tables

body.title: Forward the docs area at both dispatch tables
body.summary: Give doc.mention an area argument forwarded to retrieveDocSections; make the one-shot RUNNERS dispatch adapters and the step NARROW_RUNNERS.prepare adapters (separate code paths) for doc.mention, doc.decision-trace and doc.constraint-enumerate pass docsAreaOf(ctx.scope); repo and workspace scopes pass no area.
acceptanceChecks: a file and a module docs plan returns no section outside the area on both execution modes
with no candidate in the area no embedding runs
repo and workspace scopes call retrieval as before

tests.name: doc-area-forwarding.test.ts: the adapters for doc.mention, doc.decision-trace and doc.constraint-enumerate forward docsAreaOf(ctx.scope) for file and module scopes and no area for repo or workspace scopes
docs-retrieval.test.ts: with a stubbed vector search an area passes only candidate ids inside the area, a stronger outside section never competes and no candidates performs no embedding
docs-plan-area.test.ts: complete file-scope and module-scope docs plans return no section outside the area through the step executor and the one-shot executor
